blocks.text: Pages are those the project's own search returns for "Uganda", so some only mention it. Views are from July 2015; sizes are the current size of each page.

items.b: 373 pages on Wikinews mention Uganda, written from 2005 onward and read 1,049,265 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 2,038 times.
“Pakistan International Airlines sacrifices goat, resumes ATR flights” alone holds 3.8% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 15%. Readership is spread across many pages rather than a few.
Views peaked in 2025 at 292,888. The last full year, 2025, drew 292,888, close to the peak. So far in 2026: 103,277 views.
Most pages were written in 2009 (97). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 15 pages were written, against 9 in the five years before that — the pace is picking up.
443 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2010 (125); in 2025 there were 13. A thin recent base: a handful of people carry the upkeep.
